title: GRIEFED
description: adds a dimension that looks like the spawn of 2b2t
body:
adds a dimension that looks like the 2b2t spawn 
it has no portal or anything so youll have to use a mod or commands to get there

i reccommend playing this with a doctor who mod because a griefed world is the far future of any minecraft server if unmoderated for long enough

it also might make your computer explode but it shouldnt crash
